subject: Digital Electronics
learning_objective: Decompose an Sv39 virtual address and follow three eight-byte PTE reads to a4KiB leaf, preserving the12-bit offset.
core_conclusion: The page walk replaces the VPN with a leaf PPN while the page offset is copied unchanged.

terminology.scope: RV64 Sv39, canonical lower-half address, cold translation and4KiB page; S-mode read with valid accessible tables, U=0,R=1,A=1 leaf. Superpages, faults, TLB behavior and A/D updates are outside this numerical example.

design_audit.visualArgument: Colored bit groups become numerical indexes that select actual table rows; returned PPN values become the next base until a readable leaf replaces the VPN.
design_audit.motion: Pending read output becomes decoded PPN, traverses a continuous path to its receiver, and only arrival supplies the shifted next base or leaf PPN; then the original offset joins the physical page.
design_audit.example: VA0x404031A8 selects indexes1/2/3 and maps viaPPN0x12345 toPA0x123451A8.
design_audit.antiTemplate: Unlike load/store address addition, this changes address identity through three data-dependent table reads and a preserved offset lane.
design_audit.sceneRationale: Six scenes allocate one slice, three dependentPTE reads, one address join and one data read. Combining the middle levels would conceal the data-dependent base handoff;33seconds leaves time to read each hexadecimal result.

observations: Viewed the actual v2 final-MP4 overview, all 30 risk panels in four readable crops, and original full-size frames 285 and 615. This is a visual decision based on those images, not on source assertions.

All three table reads now show pending-to-returned PPN transitions at 8/13.5/19 s; intermediate transfer panels visibly relocate the concrete PPN toward an empty receiver. At 9.5/15/20.5 s arrival consumes the token and fills the same receiver with 0x80001000, 0x80002000 and leaf PPN 0x12345 respectively. This addresses the original failed causal read/handoff mechanism.

The overview at 3 s shows VPN2/1/0 = 1/2/3 and offset 0x1A8. The subsequent level equations use the prior delivered bases. At 25 s PA becomes 0x123451A8; at 31 s final overview shows physical memory byte 0x5A and x10=0x5A.

Main-diagram content changes through bit decomposition, three dependent reads with moving returned values, physical-address assembly, and final load. The repeated table layout carries changing causal state rather than repeated titles.

Full-size arrivals show readable PTE/address/value text, receiver and supporting copy. Receiver caption sits close to its lower border but remains legible; token/receiver overlap immediately before arrival is intentional spatial handoff, not obstruction.

prompt:
A 33-second silent English educational animation for a university digital electronics course on Sv39 Virtual Address Translation: split virtual address 0x404031A8 into VPN indexes 1/2/3 and offset 0x1A8; read PTEs at 0x80000008, 0x80001010, and 0x80002018 with returned PPNs pending until 8, 13.5, and 19 seconds respectively, then move each returned PPN into an empty receiver over 45 frames before filling it with next base 0x80001000, next base 0x80002000, or leaf PPN 0x12345; form physical address 0x123451A8 at 25 seconds with the original offset unchanged and load physical byte 0x5A into x10.

Use a radial dark background from #142238 through #0d1626 to #070b12 with a 72px grid and a #60a5fa glow; primary #60a5fa marks main fields, registers, or paths, accent #fbbf24 marks carried values and selected quantities, result #34d399 marks completed values or valid selections, and warn #f87171 marks discarded or unavailable work; use Helvetica Neue with Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI, and sans-serif fallbacks, 50px headings at weight 700, 30px body copy, and 21px uppercase kickers with 5px tracking; at 30 fps, slide-up headings 22px over 16 frames from frame 8 and stagger-in copy from frame 24 in 12-frame steps with 12-frame fades and 16px rises; marker-travel moves each returned PPN from (60,395) into receiver (555,505) over exactly 45 frames; only arrival fills that receiver with the shifted next base or leaf PPN, then an unchanged offset travels into address assembly over 90 frames; provide the Remotion source and course kit with Remotion 4.0.410, React 19.0.0, TypeScript 5.8.2, Node.js, a Chromium render environment, and FFmpeg, with 1920x1080 H264 MP4 output and no audio; exact reproduction on a clean machine has not been verified.
